info.title: Switchboard app API
info.description: REST and long-polls for the Switchboard phone apps. Approvals need a device signature; denials need only a device token.

get.summary: Files the session's worktree changed since it started, committed or not. Read-only.

post.summary:
Stops the session if it's running, removes its worktree only if clean and merged, and deletes
its Herdr session. It then leaves the session list.

One message, routed as WhatsApp routes it: a named project starts a session there, `use <x>`
picks something running, and anything else goes to `current`.

200.description: Started, sent, a question, or a refusal with its reason

parameters.name: lines
parameters.description: Lines of output; defaults to 80, capped at 500.

AgentView.description:
A Herdr agent Switchboard didn't start. It has no permission hooks, so its dialogs
are answered in Herdr.

name.description:
`<herdr session>/<agent>` when the machine runs several Herdr sessions. An agent without
a Herdr name goes by its pane id, e.g. `mono1/w1:p2`.

kind.description: e.g. `claude` or `codex`, as Herdr reports it.

title.description: Its terminal title, usually what it's working on. Untrusted text.

kind.description:
`permission`, `question` (Claude's AskUserQuestion) or `plan` (plan approval). Questions
and plans can't be answered from the app yet: approving one leaves the agent at a dialog.

input_text.description: The masked tool input as text: a shell command, or the input as JSON.

questions.description: For a question, each question's text.

deadline.description: Unix milliseconds; unanswered by then means denied.

expires_at.description: Unix milliseconds; part of the signed message.

ChangedFile.description: One file a session changed since it started.

added.description: Lines added; absent for a binary or new untracked file.

truncated.description: More files changed than are listed.

nonce.description: Required to allow: the nonce from the approval's challenge.

signature.description:
Required to allow: DER ECDSA P-256 over SHA-256 of the approval message, base64url,
made with the approval key. The message is `switchboard-approval-v1`, then `hub=`,
`device=`, `approval=`, `decision=allow`, `nonce=`, `expires=` lines, joined by `\n`.

outcome.description: The recorded outcome, `allow` or `deny`. An allow that never reached the agent is a deny.

replayed.description: Already decided; nothing was sent again.

kept_because.description: Why the worktree was kept: uncommitted or unmerged work, or a failed removal.

operation_id.description: Set with `outcome_unknown`: look the request up later by its request id.

project_id.description: Set for a project to start in.

target.description: Set for something running to send to.

MessagePreview.description: Where a message would go, without sending it.

message.description: What sending would do, or the question sending would ask, in a sentence.

machine_id.description: For `start`: the machine it would run on.

current.description: Where text that names no project goes.

request_id.description: Required, one per draft: a retried send with the same id is not sent twice.

current.description: Where text that names no project goes.

project_id.description: Answers a `choose_project`: start in this project.

target.description: Answers a `choose_target`: send to this one.

message.description: What happened, or the question to answer, in a sentence.

current.description: Where text that names no project goes from now on.

min_client_build.description: The oldest app build this hub still serves; older builds should ask to be updated.

message_version.description: The signed message version the hub accepts.

max_wait_ms.description: The longest long-poll wait the hub honours.

text.description: The agent's terminal text, masked. Untrusted: it's the agent's, not Switchboard's.

code.description: The single-use code from `switchboard admin pair-device`.

name.description: Shown in the devices list, e.g. "Adarsh's iPhone".

auth_key.description: P-256 public key, SEC1 uncompressed, base64url without padding. Signs token challenges.

approval_key.description: Same encoding. Signs approvals; the phone keeps it behind Face ID or the passcode.

fingerprint.description: Show this; the admin confirms the terminal shows the same.

token.description: The APNs device token as hex; null turns push off for this device.

label.description: Project plus the first four characters of the id, as WhatsApp shows it.

hook_failed.description: Stuck at a dialog the runner won't answer; answer it in Herdr.

notifies.description: False when muted or when mute-all is on.

herdr_session.description: The Herdr session it runs in; `herdr session attach <name>` opens it on the machine.

revision.description: Pass back as `after_revision` to wait for the next change.

machine_id.description: Defaults to the hub's default machine.

agent.description: `claude` or `codex`; defaults to the project's agent.

request_id.description: Required: a lost response can be looked up, or retried, by this id.

outcome.description:
`started`; `deduplicated` when the same start ran in the last minute ("already running");
`replayed` for a retried request id; `reconciled` when a lost reply was settled.

remove_worktree_if_clean.description: Removes the worktree only if it is clean and merged.

TargetRef.description:
Something a message can go to: a session by id, or an agent Switchboard didn't start by
machine and name.

signature.description:
DER ECDSA P-256 over SHA-256 of the token message, base64url. The message is
`switchboard-token-v1`, then `hub=`, `device=`, `nonce=`, `expires=` lines, joined by `\n`.
